Maria Chen: Heads up — noticed ~120 leads stuck in HS enrichment queue for EMEA product line, causing handoff timeout spikes. First seen 10:12 UTC. Anyone else seeing claim backlog?
Jamal Ortiz: Yup saw the spike. Round-robin started failing on rule 'country != null' — looks like a mapping mismatch from HS -> SF owner mapping. @Priya can you check the property sync?
Priya Kapoor: On it. Quick check: HubSpot workflow 'assign_owner_v2' is filtering on 'country' but field sometimes set to 'EMEA' vs 'Europe' from capture. I'll patch mapping. Also thinking we need a fallback owner for unrecognized geo.
Dan Rivers: Fallback is good. Also propose increasing heartbeat to 90s for the claim service while we patch so leads don't get TTL'd to dead-letter. Current is 30s. Ops, thoughts? @Alertbot
Alertbot: Deploy scheduled for claim-service config at 10:45 UTC if approved.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup: Approve. Also can we add temporary rule: if HS enrichment takes > 45s, route to fallback 'marketing_ops' queue. Simple JSON for HS workflow that I tested: ```json
{"action":"route","criteria":{"enrichment_time":">45"},"destination":"marketing_ops"}
```
Jamal Ortiz: Nice. For SF mapping, remember that owner mapping uses SF role IDs — when HS owner email missing we should map by lead source -> default AE. I'm going to add an edgecase in the webhook: ```js
if (!hs.owner_email) assignDefaultAE(lead.source)
```
Priya Kapoor: Patched mapping in staging. Will run smoke test with a batch of 50 synthetic leads. If green, I'll push tonight. Also adding a regex normalize to map 'Europe' <-> 'EMEA'.
Dan Rivers: We should update the SLA doc (hand-off SLO) to include this fallback behavior and heartbeat tuning. Suggest SLO: 95% of leads assigned to an AE within 60s, fallback route within 45s, dead-letter <1%.
Maria Chen: Agreed. @Jamal can you file the quick runbook steps? Keep it short — 'what to do when enrichment spikes'
Jamal Ortiz: Will do. Drafting now: 1) bump heartbeat 2) enable HS fallback route 3) normalize geo property 4) watch claim queue metrics 5) rollback if assignment errors > 1%.
Priya Kapoor: Smoke tests finished: 0 fails in 50. Pushing to prod in 15. Will monitor.
Maria Chen: Excellent. After prod, let's run a 2-hour postmortem checklist. Also add a one-pager to marketing ops on how to claim fallback leads.
Dan Rivers: :eyes: Logging that. Thanks team. I'll update the SLA doc and add to the playbook repo: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/lead-handoff
HubSpot Sync Bot: Webhook delivery delay alert cleared — average delivery 1.2s in last 10m.
Alertbot: Claim-service config deploy started (10:46 UTC).
Maria Chen: Thanks all :party_parrot:
